# Webflow Migration Expert

> Damir A., a Webflow Certified developer, migrates websites to Webflow from WordPress, Wix, Framer, Squarespace, HubSpot, Shopify and other platforms. 40+ Webflow migrations, Top Rated on Upwork with 100% Job Success. Every URL is mapped and 301 redirected so SEO survives the move. Most migrations take 2 to 3 weeks.
